facts.fact: Co-Develop says an eKYC platform on MOSIP and e-Signet, with the NRC number as legal identifier, had a successful proof of concept in April 2024.
Co-Develop says the eKYC identity verification system has been extended to emergency drought relief and electronic health records after the April 2024 proof of concept.
